resolved_conflicts.explanation: The site's own register page says no coordinates are available, but the Maine list gives 45.45283, -68.71853. The record keeps the list values; the story calls them rough.

sources.title: Former Fire Lookout Sites, Maine list

notes_for_editor: History rests on two Maine state-archive pages (Maine Memory and the Digital Maine 1919 map) plus the register. No source read describes the site today, so the story says so. The register page gives no coordinates while the Maine list gives 45.45283, -68.71853; the story notes they are rough. Maine Memory photo item 19121 (Forest Service lookout tower and camp, ca. 1920) is noted but its image URL and license were not read, so no photo is added. The register's 'tower' is a 48-foot steel tower per the 1917 replacement. Used 1 websearch.py call and about 5 page reads.
